notes: Actions can now differ per platform, take keyboard shortcuts, and hold a conversation from a script — ctx.prompt, confirm, choose, pick a file or folder — with JS highlighting, autocomplete and a save-time syntax check. New preview blocks: ::: carousel, ::: download, ::: pagelink and ::: embed, and pasting a YouTube or Vimeo link offers the embed for you. Plus AI actions with your choice of provider, dictation, and a Settings window.

win.notes: Menu shortcuts are handled natively now. Ctrl+P is Open Quickly, and with no folder open it does nothing at all rather than putting up the webview’s print sheet. The browser shortcuts that never belonged to a text editor went with it: Ctrl+F is Nib’s own Find rather than a find bar, and Ctrl+R no longer reloads the document out from under you. The web inspector is no longer reachable in the shipped app (tinyjs 0.37).
